o: We must find the minimum **positive** sum among all contiguous subarrays whose length lies in [l, r]. In Example 1, [3,-2] has length 2 and sum 1, the smallest positive sum. In Example 2 every window of length 2–3 has sum ≤ 0, so we return -1. With n ≤ 100, even an O(n³) scan passes, but prefix sums reduce this to O(n²) or O(n·(r−l+1)). Negative numbers mean a longer window isn't necessarily larger, so we cannot prune greedily — we must examine all windows.
k: Prefix sums turn any subarray sum into a subtraction: sum(i..j) = P[j+1] − P[i].
Because negatives exist, every window in the length range must be checked; no greedy pruning is safe.
Answer is -1 only if no window in range has a positive sum.

a.i: Build a prefix-sum array once, then enumerate every starting index and every allowed length, reading each window's sum in O(1). Track the minimum strictly-positive sum.
s: Compute prefix sums P where P[k] = nums[0] + ... + nums[k-1].
For each start i and length L in [l, r], let j = i + L; skip if j > n.
If P[j] - P[i] > 0, update the answer with this value.
Return the answer, or -1 if it was never updated.
a.t: O(n · (r − l + 1)) ≤ O(n²) — each window sum is read in O(1) from the prefix array.

a.i: For each fixed length L, slide a window across the array updating the running sum in O(1) per step. This avoids the prefix array entirely and is equally fast given the small constraints.
s: For each L from l to r:
Compute the sum of the first window nums[0..L-1].
Slide right: add nums[i], subtract nums[i-L], checking positivity each step.
Track the global minimum positive sum; return -1 if none found.
a.t: O(n · (r − l + 1)) — each length is scanned once with O(1) window updates.
a.sp: O(1) extra space beyond the input.

w: Use the prefix-sum version in an interview — it generalizes better. Pitfalls: forgetting the strict 'sum > 0' filter, allowing windows shorter than l or longer than r, and returning 0 instead of -1 when nothing qualifies. Follow-ups: what if l = r (single length, pure sliding window), or if you needed the maximum positive sum instead?
